mechanism_narrative: Elevated grocery-and-pharmacy traffic above +25 percent while transit remains more than 10 points below baseline means household trip budgets are still allocated to essential provisioning rather than discretionary outings; with the essentials share not decaying week-on-week, retail-and-recreation footfall stays at or below its current level over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM holds +24.7 to +28.3 across all four weeks while TRANSIT holds -11.1 to -13.9
failure_condition: If mean RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 2020-11-15 exceeds the prior 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays above +25 and TRANSIT stays below -10 for the full window, this substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The parks series dropped 4.0 points in the single week to t-1w (from -10.0 to -14.0) and stayed there at t-0w, which registers a behavioural withdrawal from outdoor discretionary activity; the same caution that suppresses park visits suppresses browsing and leisure shopping, so retail-and-recreation weakens within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 3 points in a single week (observed: -10.0 at t-2w to -14.0 at t-1w)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS step down of 4.0 points at t-1w with no rebound at t-0w
regime_hint: behavioural caution after a parks-activity step-down
failure_condition: If PARKS declines by more than 3 points in a week and the subsequent two-week mean of RETAIL_REC is not below the pre-drop two-week mean in a majority of such episodes, the drop is noise rather than a caution signal and the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Workplaces mobility has recovered to -3.9 while transit stays near -12.4, so the office return is being served by local, short-radius trips rather than by the transit network; those trips generate neighbourhood daytime footfall that lifts retail-and-recreation above its current level over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises above -5.0 while TRANSIT remains below -10.0 (observed: WORKPLACES -3.3/-3.9 versus TRANSIT -12.1/-12.4)
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is 8.5 points higher than TRANSIT at t-0w
regime_hint: partial reopening with suppressed transit capacity
failure_condition: If the WORKPLACES-minus-TRANSIT gap stays above 5 points for four weeks and mean RETAIL_REC over the following 28 days is not higher than the prior 28-day mean, the local-trip substitution channel is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility running above +5 percent while workplaces sit at or below -3.9 defines an active stay-at-home regime: policy and employer directives are keeping the population at home during working hours, which denies retail-and-recreation venues the weekday customer base and pulls its four-week mean lower.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL between +5.9 and +7.3 in all four weeks with WORKPLACES negative in all four weeks
regime_hint: tightening restrictions with enforced home stay
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains above +5 and WORKPLACES below 0 for the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean, the stay-at-home suppression path is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Grocery-and-pharmacy demand rose for three straight weeks and then plateaued (27.6 to 28.3 to 27.9), indicating that the stockpiling wave has exhausted itself; as pantry replenishment stops absorbing household spend, grocery trips fall back toward baseline and the released budget flows to retail-and-recreation within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM prints a value below its trailing four-week maximum for two consecutive weeks (observed: 27.9 at t-0w after 28.3 at t-1w)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM sequence 24.7, 27.6, 28.3, 27.9 shows a peak and first down-print
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM rolls over from its peak for two or more weeks and RETAIL_REC over the following 28 days is not higher than the prior 28-day mean, the budget-reallocation hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Transit and residential series move in near lockstep in opposite directions, and the small week-on-week wobble in retail-and-recreation (0.7 points of range) is too small to break that coupling inside one week; the one-week-ahead move in RETAIL_REC is therefore governed by the transit-residential spread and is flat to slightly negative.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT range 2.8 points and RESIDENTIAL range 1.4 points across the four weeks, versus RETAIL_REC range 0.7 points
regime_hint: steady state with stable small-amplitude mobility noise
failure_condition: If the one-week-ahead change in RETAIL_REC has zero or positive mean whenever the transit-residential spread is unchanged or widening, the short-horizon coupling hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Retail-and-recreation has been pinned in a narrow band from -12.6 to -13.3 for four weeks, which is a policy ceiling rather than a demand floor; if that ceiling holds while residential stays above +5, capacity limits and distancing rules remain binding and the next four-week mean cannot exceed the last.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC fails to exceed -12.0 for two consecutive weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays above +5.0 (observed: -13.3 and -13.1 versus +6.0 and +6.3)
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC band of 0.7 points over four weeks with RESIDENTIAL above +5.9 throughout
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC breaks above -12.0 within two weeks while RESIDENTIAL stays above +5.0, the restriction-ceiling interpretation is wrong and the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Parks mobility falling to -13.4 while residential stays above +6 marks the seasonal shift of leisure time indoors as outdoor conditions worsen in mid-November; displaced leisure demand is redirected to indoor commercial venues, raising retail-and-recreation over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS drops below -12.0 while RESIDENTIAL remains above +5.0 (observed: PARKS -14.0/-13.4 with RESIDENTIAL +6.0/+6.3)
failure_condition: If PARKS stays below -12.0 with RESIDENTIAL above +5.0 for two weeks and RETAIL_REC is not higher in the following two weeks than in the preceding two weeks, the indoor-substitution mechanism is rejected.
